{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''There's'' our traitor&mdash;''Raice Liq of the Banking Clan''... And he's taken the ''bait''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Prize Contender">{{TCWComicCite|6.11|Prize Contender}}</ref>}}
'''Raice Liq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], who operated on behalf of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] [[President/Legends|President]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Liq's job was essentially to gather information about weapons used by [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|troops]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
